field.label: Enable Docker
field.help: Enable the Alpine Linux bhyve microVM and background Docker service.

field.label: Virtual CPUs
field.help: Number of virtual CPU cores allocated to the Docker microVM (1 to Host Core Count).

field.label: RAM Allocation (MB)
field.help: RAM memory allocated to the Docker microVM in Megabytes (e.g. 2048 for 2GB, 4096 for 4GB).

field.label: Data Disk Size (GB)
field.help: Storage capacity allocated for /var/lib/docker container layers and volumes in Gigabytes. Stored as a sparse file.

field.label: VM Bridge Subnet
field.help: RFC 6598 carrier-grade NAT bridge network for the microVM. Default: 100.64.0.0/24.

field.label: Dynamic Port Forwarding
field.help: Automatically forward published container ports (-p host:container) via PF firewall rules.

field.label: Port Conflict Protection
field.help: Prevent containers from binding ports already in use by host services (WebGUI, Unbound DNS, SSH) and raise an alert.

field.label: Log Level
field.help: Select the logging verbosity for the Docker daemon and sync service.
